findings.evidence: `Completion.lean:287` defines the universal property, `:268` `isHuberRing_completion_locTopology`, `:247` `continuous_toCompletionLoc` — the only declarations the proof cites (Restriction.lean:72-76). `wc -l Completion.lean` = 325, so no length pressure motivates the split. Restriction.lean's only import is `…LocalizationTopology.Completion`.
findings.fix: Move the theorem into `LocalizationTopology/Completion.lean` immediately after `existsUnique_continuous_ringHom_completion_locTopology` (add it to that file's `## Main results`), and delete `Restriction.lean`; create that module when a map between two presentations is actually constructed.
findings.issue: `eq_id_of_comp_toCompletionLoc` elaborates `existsUnique_continuous_ringHom_completion_locTopology` and uses nothing outside `LocalizationTopology/Completion.lean` (`locUniformSpace`, `toCompletionLoc`, `continuous_toCompletionLoc`, `isHuberRing_completion_locTopology`, the universal property). Its statement quantifies over endomorphisms of one `A⟨T/s⟩`; no second presentation `T'`, `s'` occurs. A new module whose title is 'Restriction between completed rational localisations' therefore contains no restriction map, and the material sits one file later than its dependencies allow.

summary: The single theorem is an endomorphism-uniqueness corollary of the universal property and depends only on declarations in LocalizationTopology/Completion.lean; it belongs there, not in a new module named for restriction maps that the PR does not construct.
